title: Regulatory Compliance Data Retention
business: Financial institutions requiring long-term, immutable record-keeping for audit compliance.
problem: Rising operational costs from storing massive volumes of historical transaction logs in standard storage classes that are rarely accessed.
solution: Utilizing Google Cloud Archive Storage to move infrequently accessed, long-term data into a low-cost storage class specifically designed for data retention.
steps: Identify historical transaction datasets that meet the criteria for long-term retention.
Create a Cloud Storage bucket configured with the Archive storage class.
Implement Lifecycle Management policies to automatically transition objects to Archive storage after a defined period.
Verify data integrity and accessibility for infrequent audit requests.
outcome: Significant reduction in storage expenditures while maintaining compliance with regulatory data retention mandates.
limitation: Archive storage is optimized for data that is rarely accessed; retrieving data incurs higher costs and longer latency compared to standard classes, which can be checked by monitoring retrieval frequency and latency metrics.
